title: Implicit Association Test
description: Behavioural paradigm measuring implicit associations between target concepts and attributes through reaction-time differences in categorisation tasks.

publication.citation: Greenwald AG, McGhee DE, Schwartz JLK. Measuring individual differences in implicit cognition: The Implicit Association Test. J Pers Soc Psychol. 1998;74(6):1464-1480.

x_internal_notes: Multiple variants exist (race, gender, age, etc.); each is its own concrete instrument referencing this paradigm.
